articles.title: Iran-linked entities moved $3.8B through CoinEx, TRM says
articles.snippet: TRM Labs traced $3.8 billion moved by 60 sanctioned Iranian entities through CoinEx and said that the exchange’s 8% share of illicit transactions was substantially higher than its counterparts.

articles.title: Kalshi seeks funding at $40B valuation, nearly doubling last raise: FT
articles.snippet: Kalshi is reportedly in talks to raise new capital at a $40 billion valuation, reflecting growing investor confidence in regulated prediction markets.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Strategy’s MSTR and STRC Crash to 52-Week Lows
articles.snippet: A massive Micron earnings beat has lifted global markets, pushing crypto higher after yesterday's nasty sell off took BTC sub-$60k.

articles.title: Kalshi Seeks $40B Valuation Weeks After $1B Raise: FT
articles.snippet: The prediction market seeks a valuation near double the $22 billion it hit last month, as a federal-state fight over regulation escalates.

articles.title: Leaked Code Suggests Anthropic Is Preparing to Bring Fable 5 Back
articles.snippet: A leaker found new strings inside Claude Code that hint at weekly Fable 5 usage built into subscription plans, not sold separately as before.
